newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-UEFA TO EXPAND EUROPEAN UNDER-21 CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UEFA TO EXPAND EUROPEAN UNDER-21 CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: UEFA, European soccer's governing body, said on Wednesday it expected a proposal to expand the European under-21 championship final round from four to eight teams to be accepted on Thursday.
Under the proposal, which is expected to receive UEFA executive committee approval at their meeting in Antalya, Turkey, the competition would take on a single knock-out format.
The championship would be hosted by one of the competing associations and staged over an 11-or-12 day period before the end of May in alternate years.
The reasons for increasing the number of finalists coincides with an increase of interest and income generated by the championship.

The four finalists in this year's championship, which was won by Italy in a shootout over Spain, each received 821,840 Swiss francs ($657,200). Two years earlier in France, the four associations received 112,742 Swiss francs ($90,130).
